xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3109: DoD close-out gate blind to non-PR-path landings — merged row needs the membership resolver's branch-containment lens

plan.title: DoD close-out gate blind to non-PR-path landings — merged row needs the membership resolver's branch-containment lens
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The DoD close-out gate's merged row (checkMergedRow, src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts:236-294) only accepts the verify-merged step, a durable merge record, or a merged forge PR. Work that landed via a non-PR path — e.g. the four MYN issues whose branches live in polyrepo sub-repos while ctx.projectPath is the repo-less wrapper — misses row 4 (and row 5 downstream) forever, even though the pipeline-membership resolver already derives 'branch work contained in main, no merged PR' from its L2-work containment lens. The gate refuses its own remedy: membership says 'run close-out', close-out fails the gate.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the membership gather's branch-containment computation (contained in default branch + tip off its first-parent line = merged work; not-contained = unmerged; contained on first-parent = pointer) into shared exported helpers in src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts, add an issue-scoped gatherIssueBranchContainment over projectRepositories(project), and use it as a fallback in checkMergedRow: when the row would miss and no merged PR exists, pass iff at least one merged-work ref exists and zero unmerged refs exist across all project repos. Tag the pass with evidence: 'branch-containment' and let checkPostMergeRow accept that evidence when no work/plan agents are running. Rows 1-3 stay operator --accept-* territory.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to rows 1-3 (review/tests/verification) — operator --accept-* territory for non-PR landings
- No derivation of a merge commit for non-PR landings; rows 6-7 (main-verify, deploy) semantics unchanged
- No change to membership resolver/gather classification outcomes (extract-and-reuse only)
- No fast-forward-landing detection (PAN-2887 blind spot stays: pointer refs never count as merge evidence)
- No fix for PAN-2828's pan done --strike ancestry check
- No per-repo partial-failure tolerance in the containment helper (git failure = evidence unavailable = row stays miss)

autoDecisions.summary: Shared lens lives in pipeline-membership-gather.ts (export projectRepositories, extract snapshot + classification helpers, add gatherIssueBranchContainment) rather than a new module or a copy in dod-gate.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The gather is the canonical membership door and the issue explicitly demands 'reuse its lens, don't fork a second implementation'; one implementation with two callers makes drift structurally impossible.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 4 flips to pass iff mergedWorkRefs > 0 AND unmergedRefs == 0 across all configured project repositories.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors resolvePipelineMembership precedence exactly (branchLive wins over merged-work, pipeline-membership.ts:102,146-155), so the two doors agree by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 5 accepts evidence: 'branch-containment' only with zero running work/plan agents; the lifecycle-observed half is waived for non-PR landings.
autoDecisions.rationale: The post-merge lifecycle can never have observed a merge event the system never saw; agent quiescence is the half of the invariant that remains meaningful and checkable.

autoDecisions.summary: Containment passes carry no mergedAt/mergeCommit; git failures in the helper leave the row miss with the error appended to observed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Never fabricate merge metadata (rows 6-7 already skip/degrade gracefully without it), and fail-closed evidence gathering keeps the gate honest.

narrative.Action: Per PRD D1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-3109.md): in src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts, export the ProjectRepository interface (line 279) and projectRepositories (line 284). Extract the per-repo snapshot block (lines 314-334: the three git commands for-each-ref refs, for-each-ref --no-merged=<defaultBranch>, rev-list --first-parent <defaultBranch>) into an exported snapshotBranchRefs(repoPath, defaultBranch, refPatterns, run) and the per-ref decision (lines 392-411) into a pure exported classifyBranchRefLine(line, unmergedSet, firstParentShas) returning 'unmerged' | 'merged-work' | 'pointer'. Add exported interface IssueBranchContainment { unmergedRefs: string[]; mergedWorkRefs: string[]; pointerRefs: string[] } and exported async gatherIssueBranchContainment(project: ProjectConfig, issueId: string, run = defaultDeps.run): Promise<IssueBranchContainment> that iterates projectRepositories(project) with issue-scoped ref patterns (refs/heads/feature/<id-lower>, refs/remotes/origin/feature/<id-lower>, refs/heads/strike/<id-lower>, refs/remotes/origin/strike/<id-lower>) and aggregates classified refs qualified with their repo path. Rewire gatherProjectLensSignals through the extracted helpers so classification exists exactly once; its outputs must be byte-identical to today. Git failures propagate (PRD D2). Add unit tests with an injected fake run covering: merged-work ref detected (contained + tip off first-parent), pointer ref ignored, unmerged ref reported, multi-repo aggregation (one repo merged-work + one repo pointer), and strike/ ref inclusion.

Given a polyrepo project with two configured repos, the helper aggregates refs across both repo paths and preserves each repo's configured default branch in the git arguments

narrative.Action: Per PRD W2/D3 (.pan/drafts/PAN-3109.md): in src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts add evidence?: 'branch-containment' to MergedDodRowResult (line 44) and readBranchContainment?: (ctx: LifecycleContext) => Promise<IssueBranchContainment> to MergedRowDeps (line 49). Default implementation resolves the project via resolveProjectForIssue(ctx.issueId) ?? getProjectConfigFromWorkspacePath(ctx.projectPath) (same chain as readDurableMerges at lines 74-77) and calls gatherIssueBranchContainment from ../pipeline-membership-gather.js; when no project resolves, return { unmergedRefs: [], mergedWorkRefs: [], pointerRefs: [] }. In checkMergedRow after the branchAbsent fallback block (lines 281-291): if merged.status === 'miss', call the dep inside try/catch; on { mergedWorkRefs.length > 0 && unmergedRefs.length === 0 } set status 'pass', set evidence = 'branch-containment', and append '; branch work contained in default branch with no merged PR — non-PR landing (membership L2-work lens): <mergedWorkRefs joined>' to observed; leave mergedAt/mergeCommit unset (PRD D5). On throw, append '; branch containment evidence unavailable: <message>' and keep miss. Do not call the dep when the row already passes. In src/lib/lifecycle/dod.ts line 31 change the merged row's expected to 'PR merged on the forge, or branch work contained in main (non-PR landing)'. Add deps-injected tests following the existing checkMergedRow style (tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts:125-213).
